description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing long-term support, modern language features (records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads), improved performance, and enhanced security over older JDK versions.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (Maven or Gradle) to target Java 25. Resolve any compilation errors or deprecation issues introduced by the Java version change. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded project from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images. Build passes successfully with 22 source files compiled targeting release 25.
